result.title: Toward Agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Enterprise Retail Workflows over Heterogeneous Data Sources
result.summary: Enterprise retail workflows require agents to chain evidence across heterogeneous sources, from structured product and order records to unstructured inquiries and reviews, yet existing agentic RAG benchmarks rarely capture this challenge. To enable controlled evaluation of such workflows, we introduce RetailBridge, a compositional retail benchmark built from persona-driven simulations. Its questions are constructed by linking entities and intermediate answers across heterogeneous sources, requiring agents to identify the relevant sources, carry evidence between them, and produce a grounded answer. To systematically evaluate LLMs on these retail workflows, we develop RetailRAG, a retail-aware framework equipped with auto-schema briefing, source-routed plan chaining, and diagnostic plan revision. RetailRAG consistently outperforms existing agentic RAG baselines across all evaluation axes, serving as a strong reference system for assessing LLM agents on retail workflows. On RetailBridge, evaluating ten LLM backbones with RetailRAG reveals multi-source chaining as the dominant bottleneck across providers and model scales, suggesting that reliable retail agents require explicit cross-source orchestration rather than scaling alone. Code and data are publicly available at \url{https://github.com/DISL-Lab/RetailBridge}.

AI.brief_summary: 论文构建 RetailBridge 零售组合式基准（基于 persona 模拟、跨异构数据源连接实体与中间答案）与 RetailRAG 框架（自动 schema 简报、源路由计划链、诊断式计划修订），并在其上评估十个 LLM 主干，指出多源串联是主要瓶颈。
AI.relevance_reason: 虽为纯文本 agentic RAG、不涉及视觉或 latent 状态，但其源路由、跨源证据携带与计划修订机制，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与 THINK/LOOK/STOP 编排提供可核查的方法线索。
